name: e7
description: E7 rejection timing: for all 22 signature schemes, verify with a valid signature, the same signature with one bit flipped and a valid signature over a different message of the same length; for all 8 KEMs, decaps of a valid ciphertext and of the same ciphertext with one bit flipped. Arms interleaved in one process, each with the full approved budget; the classification is the operation's (E1), batch sizes from trial-e7; 5 repetitions. Every call's outcome is checked and recorded.
